spans.s:
mfn. (न्तः-न्ता-न्तं-)
Insensible, inanimate.
E.
अ neg. चिन्ता reflexion.

f. (-न्ता)
Disregard, absence of thought or consideration.
E.
अ neg. चिन्ता thought.

f. (-ता)
Insensibility, want of sense or intellect.
E.
ता added to the last.

mfn. (-त-ता-तं)
1 Unthought of, unexpected.
2 Disregarded.
E.
अ neg. चिन्तित considered.

mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं)
Inconceivable, unimaginable, incomprehensible.
E.
अ neg. चिन्त्य conceivable.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Brief, momentary, not long.
(-रा)
A proper name, the mother of ŚĀNTI, the sixteenth Jaina saint.
E.
अ neg. चिर long.

f. (-तिः)
Lightning.
E.
अ neg. चिर long, and द्युति light.

f. (-भा)
Lightning.
E.
अचिर as before, and प्रभा light.

f. (-चिः)
Lightning.
E.
अचिर as before, and रोचिस् light.

f. (-शुः)
Lightning.
E.
अचिर and अंशु a ray.

ind.
Directly, without delay.
E.
अ neg. and चिरात् from length of time.

f. (-भा)
Lightning.
E.
अचिर as above, and भा light, with आङ prefixed.

Spread, diffused.
mn. (-तः-तं)
1 A measure of ten

A cart load.
E.
आङ् and the past participle of चिञ् to collect.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Holding an Ācita.
E.
आचित and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Holding or equal to an Ācita.
E.
आचित and ख aff.
